summary: Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, disclosing board approval of a spin-off of MSGS Spinco, Inc. Shareholders receive one Spinco Class A share per two MSGS Class A shares and one Spinco Class B share per two MSGS Class B shares, with a record date of October 20, 2026 and distribution effective 11:59 p.m. October 26, 2026. Completion is conditioned on Form 10 effectiveness, NYSE listing approval, a contribution, NHL final approval and a tax opinion; the board may modify or abandon. Watch NHL approval timing and when-issued trading.
